name: CHATA
subtitle: The Cabin Near Trenčín
description: Six friends, a wooden cabin in the mountains above Trenčín, way too much borovička, and a drive nobody should have taken. Based on a true story. English + Slovak.

name: KIKOMORPHOSYS
subtitle: Everything Was Normal
description: Mentos drives Kiko to the gas station and snaps a photo. Smile, you ugly bastard. In the snap, Kiko's face is wrong. They delete it. The next morning it is back, and worse, and back home in Dubnica nad Váhom, Kiko is slowly turning into the thing in the photo. Prologue + 4 chapters. English + Slovak.

name: DRIFTY
subtitle: Sideways Through the Night Garage
description: A wet underground garage, a round concrete rotunda and a loop over the city at night. Pick Mentos, Kiko, Veronica or Christian, take one of their ten cars (M5 E60, E36, M3 CSL, CLS 63, M4, a Sprinter...), tune it and hold the slide for points. Multiplayer: host a lobby or invite a friend straight from their profile in the launcher.
